liedown2: A person sitting on the edge of a high bed turns the body, lies down on their back and lifts both legs onto the bed, then rests still.
getup2: A person lying on their back on a bed sits up, turns and puts both feet down on the floor, ending seated on the edge of the bed.
readturn: A person sits on a chair holding an open book with the left hand and turns a page with the right hand, then holds the book with both hands again.
sitidle: A person sits on a chair, relaxed, leans back a little and slowly looks around.
inspect: A person stands at a table, picks up a small object, inspects it closely turning it in both hands, and puts it back down.
